subject: Can I constrain quadratic effect in mixed effect model?

messages.author: 6a75f6f91a59c568
messages.subject: Can I constrain quadratic effect in mixed effect model?
parts:
Hello, Phil.

Can I constrain quadratic effect in mixed effect model? If unavailable, Can I use ~1|items:items in random effect argument?

Like this;

data(SAT12)
data <- key2binary(SAT12,
                   key = c(1,4,5,2,3,1,2,1,3,1,2,4,2,1,5,3,4,4,1,4,3,3,4,1,3,5,1,3,1,5,4,5))
model.quad <- '
F1 = 1-32
(F1*F1) = 1-32'
(mod.quad <- mirt(data, model.quad, itemtype = 'ideal'))
summary(mod.quad)
 
mod.quad.mixed <- mixedmirt(data, model.quad, itemtype = 'ideal', fixed = ~1, random = ~1|blahblah)


Best regards,
Seongho Bae

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Can I constrain quadratic effect in mixed effect model?
parts:
Hi Seongho,

Yes to the first part, no to the second. Though the 'ideal' itemtype is not supported in mixedmirt (only a handful of IRT models can be expressed in this framework).

Phil
